packets.title: Under-the-Radar Girls' Getaway in the South: Things to Do in Ridgeland, Mississippi
packets.summary: Angie Orth (@angieaway, angieaway.com) publishes a first-person four-day Ridgeland itinerary (URL date 2026-07-20): Day 1 hotel check-in + CAET dinner + Renaissance Show Fountain; Day 2 Barnett Reservoir, Bill Waller Craft Center, CW Organics tea room, Allison Avery bead bar, PaTina head spa, Tico's Steakhouse; Day 3 Natchez Trace biking, Cock of the Walk, Retail Trail, Buenos Aires Bakery, Wildflower Field, Anjou; Day 4 breakfast and fly home. Stay22 booking link on AC Hotel Jackson Ridgeland; 'book ahead' CTAs for head spa, Tico's and dinner reservations. Trip hosted in partnership with Explore Ridgeland (DMO press trip, not a group trip).

items.name: AC Hotel Jackson Ridgeland
items.details: Check-in hotel for the trip; walkable to The Township at Colony Park, Fusion Coffeehouse and Anjou. Stay22 booking link on the hotel name in the Where to Stay section.

items.name: CAET
items.details: Dinner day 1: oyster / small plates spot; raw bar, truffle fries, beef carpaccio, oysters Rockefeller, redfish, steak.

items.name: Renaissance Show Fountain
items.details: Free synchronized water, light and music show nightly 6-9pm outside Malco Renaissance Cinema Grill.

items.name: E.A.T.S Diner
items.details: Breakfast day 2: biscuits and gravy, beignets; no liquor before 10am.

items.name: Fusion Coffeehouse
items.details: Iced coffees to go from locally owned coffeehouse.

items.name: Barnett Reservoir ("The Rez")
items.location: Old Trace Park, 422 Post Road, Ridgeland, MS; Reservoir Overlook, Natchez Trace Parkway, Madison, MS
items.details: Morning day 2: shoreline walk at Old Trace Park and Reservoir Overlook; Pearl River Kayaks offers rentals for getting on the water.

items.name: Bill Waller Craft Center
items.details: Home of the Craftsmen's Guild of Mississippi; pottery, glasswork, textiles, Choctaw baskets, jewelry; best local souvenir shopping.

items.name: CW Organics Apothicaire & Tea Room
items.details: Lunch/tea day 2: tiered tea service for two; caramel cake standout; dozens of tea flavors to take home.

items.name: Allison Avery
items.details: Demi-fine jewelry flagship in the Railroad District; Charm Bar and Bead Bar build-your-own custom pieces.

items.name: PaTina Head Spa
items.details: Head spa treatment (~90 min scalp massage/wash/exfoliation + neck/shoulder massage). Book ahead; fills fast on weekends.

items.name: Tico's Steakhouse
items.location: 1536 E County Line Rd, Ridgeland, MS
items.details: Dinner day 2: Ridgeland institution since 1989. Book ahead, especially when the legislature is in session.

items.name: Celebrate America Balloon Glow
items.location: Northpark, 1200 E County Line Rd, Ridgeland, MS
items.details: Seasonal summer event: ~15 hot air balloons light up at nightfall, followed by early-4th fireworks. Check calendar; one day a year.

items.name: Whirl Smoothie Bar & Coffee House
items.details: Morning day 3: acai bowls and coffee at the Chisha-Foka Multi-Use Trail trailhead.

items.name: Ridgeland Bikeshare / Chisha-Foka Trail
items.details: Free on-demand bikeshare via the Koloni app (download before the trip); nearly 10-mile paved Chisha-Foka Multi-Use Trail.

items.name: Natchez Trace Parkway / Cypress Swamp Boardwalk
items.details: Drive the Trace (do not speed - national park tickets are steep); Cypress Swamp boardwalk among towering cypress trees.

items.name: Cock of the Walk
items.details: Lunch day 3: catfish institution on the Reservoir; coleslaw, hushpuppies, fried catfish/shrimp/chicken on tin plates.

items.name: Ridgeland Retail Trail
items.details: Shopping districts: Renaissance at Colony Park, Township at Colony Park, Northpark Mall, Railroad District, Highway 51 antiques.

items.name: Buenos Aires Bakery
items.details: Argentinian bakery; viral fruit pastries (mango, pear, pineapple) with shattering candy shells.

items.name: Ridgeland Wildflower Field & Art Park
items.details: Zinnia field with upcycled scrap-metal sculptures by Harry Day; visitors may clip up to a dozen blooms.

items.name: Anjou
items.details: Dinner day 3: French bistro in The Township; escargot, French onion soup, steak, creme brulee. Book dinner reservations ahead.

items.name: Malco Renaissance Cinema Grill
items.location: Renaissance at Colony Park, Ridgeland, MS
items.details: Movie stop on day 3 per the itinerary at-a-glance.

items.name: AC Hotel breakfast / depart JAN
items.details: Final morning: breakfast at the AC Hotel (new breakfast menu), short drive back to JAN; flew American via Charlotte.
